description: Tracks every natural-language prompt that drove a commit to this repo. Maintained by Claude — append a new entry before each commit.

entries.prompt_summary: Bootstrap the agentic company pipeline: orchestrator agent for intent routing, coder agent for code generation + GitHub commits, knowledge base agent, support agent, LangGraph multi-agent workflow, Slack notifications, Langfuse tracing, Docker Compose stack, .env template
Upgrade Langfuse from v2 to v4: migrate tracing SDK, add per-span token + cost tracking to orchestrator and coder agents, update Docker Compose to Langfuse v3 server image, fix requirements

Complete Langfuse v4 SDK migration across all agents, add ClickHouse + MinIO services to Docker Compose for analytics storage, generate changelogs for deployed features, update intent classifier routing

Wednesday milestone: build infra agent (Docker local deploy + ngrok URL to Slack), BA/compliance agent (requirements analysis + regulatory checks), UX/UI agent (wireframe generation), expand knowledge base agent, add Chroma vector memory layer, add Google Drive document ingestion
Fix pipeline bugs found during Wednesday verification run: BA/compliance agent output schema, UX/UI agent tool call format, Langfuse OTEL span propagation, main.py orchestration error handling
Fix infra agent: after successful Docker deployment, update the shared feature registry to set the deployed feature's status to 'deployed' so other agents can observe it

Thursday milestone: build architect agent (high-level code review + design proposals), PR review agent (diff analysis + quality gate), security agent (OWASP checks + vulnerability scan), GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline (lint, test, build, deploy), Slack slash command handlers
entries.milestone: Thursday — architect + PR review + security + CI/CD

entries.prompt_summary: Fix Langfuse OTEL integration and architect agent bugs: fix span context inheritance so child spans link to parent traces, add core registry module for agent self-registration, fix Docker Compose network config for OTEL exporter endpoint
